1. Scope — Specifies dimensions and material of camera accessory shoes, with and without electrical 
contacts, for photoflash lamps and electronic photofiash units. 

2. Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 

2.1 The dimensions given in Fig. 1 are basic for the solid shoes. When an accessory shoe is equipped 
with springs or other devices for holding the accessory foot tightly or maintaining good electrical 
contact, the dimensions of the shoe may be changed within the range in which their interchangeability 
and functions will not be affected. ^

Note 1 — Dimensions D, G, L and M shall be symmetric to dimension A with a tolerance of ± 0'25 mm.

IS: 10547-1983 

3. Material — The shoe contacts shall be made of a material suitable for the purpose. They shall be 
plated with one of the following metals: 

a) Gold, 

b) Silver (non-tarnishable), or 

c) Niclcel. 

4. Constructional Details 

4.1 Accessory Shoes With and Without Electrical Contacts 

4.1 .1 Clearance for the accessory equipment 

4.1.1.1 A rectangular area, area A of Fig. 2, extending 12'5 mm in front and 25'0 mm at the back 
of the shoe and 25'0 mm to the right and to the left of the centre of the shoe, shall be devoid 
of obstructions higher than 2"0 mm above the top surface of the shoe. 

4.1.1.2 A circular area, area S of Fig. 2 of diameter 30'0 mm located as dimensioned in Fig. 2, 
shall be devoid of obstructions higher than the top surface of the shoe. 

4.1 .2 Clearance for insertion of the accessory equipment foot — A rectangular area, area C of Fig. 2, 
extending 250 mm at the back of the shoe and 200 mm wide, shall be devoid of any obstruction 
above the plane of the base surface of the shoe, 

AREA A 
(Rectangular) 



AREA B 
(Circular) 




AREA C 
(Shaded) 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 2 LOCATION OF CLEARANCE AREAS 

4.2 Accessory Shoes With Electrical Contacts — The electrical contact surface (dimension G of Fig. 1) 
shall be flat and the edge rounded. The insulation resistance shall be not less than 30 MO when 
tested at a temperature between and^40°C and a relative humidity of 40 to 85 percent. 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is based on ISO 518-1977 'Photography— camera accessory shoes, with and 
without electrical contacts, for photoflash lamps and electronic photoflash units', issued by the 
International Organization for Standardization (ISO).
